root_cause: The metadata gate reserved focus breadth before qualification novelty filtering, allowing novelty-ineligible candidates to consume reserved focus slots. Readiness was then computed after novelty, so the retained bounded set could fall below 3-per-focus even when deeper novelty-eligible candidates existed in the eligible pool.
next_smallest_verified_correction: During continuous qualification only, reserve up to three production_novelty_eligible candidates per focus before general fill. Keep novelty-ineligible candidates available for traceability fill, and preserve all freshness, classification, relevance, Agent Skills and 20-candidate bounds.
